simple.meaning: שָׁאט (shâʼṭ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “one contemning.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 3 times in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 16:57. The surrounding contexts include family line, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁאט (H7590) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁאט (shâʼṭ) / H7590 is traced through Ezekiel 16:57, Ezekiel 28:24, Ezekiel 28:26 with source-language evidence and verse context.
